proposal.hypothesis: The CloudTrail event shows that the IAM user arn:aws:iam::123:user/alice successfully performed an AssumeRole operation to assume the arn:aws:iam::123:role/Admin role. This indicates that alice either had explicit permission to assume the Admin role or exploited a trust relationship, potentially resulting in unauthorized privileged access.
missing_evidence: IAM policy granting alice permission to AssumeRole on Admin role
Trust policy of the Admin role allowing alice as a principal
Evidence of justification or business need for alice to assume Admin role
Logs of actions performed by alice after assuming the Admin role
Change‑control records showing approval for this role assumption
proposal.uncertainty: Without the IAM policy and role trust documents, it is unclear whether the AssumeRole was authorized or a policy misconfiguration. The evidence confirms the action but does not prove proper authorization.

finding.title: Privileged action without approval: AssumeRole
finding.description: Privileged action AssumeRole by arn:aws:iam::123:user/alice on arn:aws:iam::123:role/Admin has no approval evidence

limitations: Evidence is limited to configured sources and retention windows.
